items.title: Wondering Why Oracle Fell? Here's What The Bears Saw
items.summary: Oracle’s AI-fueled cloud story looked powerful on paper, with analysts arguing over whether the upside or the downside case was too conservative. Holding Oracle over the past year would have meant a 48.6% loss, including dividends. If you had chosen to buy on 25 November 2025, what clues were already in view about debt, capital needs, and customer concentration before that drop played out? items.title: ‘Room to Spare,’ Says Investor About Oracle Stock
items.summary: For most of this year, the big question around Oracle (NYSE:ORCL) was whether it could pay for its data center ambitions. The company now says it can. In a Nov. 20 statement, it said all the funding for its OpenAI contract is in place. That message, along with Jensen Huang’s reinstatement at Nvidia, sent the stock sharply higher on Monday. items.title: Fleeing Stocks at 63, She Parks $700,000 of Her 401(k) in a Corporate Bond Fund for Safety. As Banks Dump Data Center Loans, a 5% Slide in Her “Safe” Fund Would Cost Her $35,000
items.summary: She fled stocks for what looked like the safest corner of her 401(k), but the bonds inside that fund belong to the same companies bankrolling the AI boom. Lenders are already getting nervous, and her Medicare bill could pay the price.

items.title: Alphabet Stocks Slip 2.13% as Credit Swaps Hit Record Amid $9.1 Billion Cash Burn
items.summary: Five-year default swaps reached a record as third-quarter capex of $51.4 billion pushed free cash flow below zero.

items.title: Oracle Stocks Sink 5.13% to 52-Week Low as Default Swaps Hit Record
items.summary: Five-year protection on Oracle debt reached 360 basis points as investors question how a $664 billion backlog gets funded.

items.title: Oracle Stock Dipped Under $100 as Banks Try to Unload Its Data-Center Loans
items.summary: Oracle's backlog is huge and the demand is real, yet lenders are quietly accepting steep discounts on the debt behind its data centers. What does the bond market see that the analysts' bullish targets don't?

items.title: Cerebras Expands AI Inference Reach: Can It Challenge NVDA & AMD?
items.summary: CBRS is ramping up its AI inference capabilities with hyperscaler partnerships, wafer-scale innovations, and expanding capacity to challenge NVIDIA and Advanced Micro Devices.

items.title: Jim Cramer Says Micron Stock Is “Comically Cheap” at About 3 Times Earnings
items.summary: Micron just posted the most profitable year in its history, yet the stock has shed a third of its value in a month. Memory's long record of boom and bust may explain why investors refuse to pay up.
